account.auto_order: If you don't register your choices in time, at 10:01 AM on Saturday we create an automatic order from your plan, your history and, always, your registered allergies.
account.intro: You're in full control of your week: choose your dishes, pause your block, check your balance and share your code.
account.mon_wed_note: Pause by Friday 7:00 PM at the latest. This is the most important cut-off: if you don't pause, your new order is assigned on Saturday at 10:00 AM and charged to your current plan.
account.no_address: You don't have an address yet.
account.pause_intro: Pause manually for surprises or trips. Windows lock automatically.
account.pause_limit: When you pause you have up to 30 calendar days to resume. After that the contract is cancelled and any accumulated balance is lost.
account.policy_pickup: If you're not home, you can pick up at no cost at an agreed time.
account.profile_text: Your profile decides which dishes are blocked and what we choose for you in the automatic selection.
account.referral_text: When a friend buys their first 4-week block (invoice paid) you get $150 MXN in credit. At 10 referred subscribers, a $500 MXN credit bonus.
account.store_text: Official tee, shaker cup and the upcoming Fit Apparel line.
account.thu_fri_note: Pause by Tuesday 10:00 AM at the latest.
account.wallet_text: Store credit (never cash). Use it as a discount on your next block or in Kulinaria Fit Apparel. Meals not prepared because of a pause are credited here.
